timeRange.description: Time range for historical data query (Unix milliseconds). Defaults to last 10 minutes when omitted.

sensorFilter.description: Optional filter selecting which sensors to include / exclude.

maxBatchesPerMessage.description: Maximum number of batches per outbound message.

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum samples per batch. Larger sensor result sets are split into multiple batches.

transmissionRateLimit.description: Transmission rate limit (messages per second). 0 disables rate limiting.
